parameters.query:
SELECT a.alert_key,
       p.platform_name,
       COALESCE(asp.aspect_name, '(toàn nền tảng)') AS aspect_name,
       a.metric_name,
       a.metric_value,
       a.threshold,
       to_jsonb(a)->>'recommended_action' AS recommended_action,
       to_jsonb(a)->>'responsible_department' AS responsible_department,
       to_char(a.detected_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AS detected_at
FROM dw.fact_alert a
JOIN dw.dim_platform p ON p.platform_key = a.platform_key
LEFT JOIN dw.dim_aspect asp ON asp.aspect_key = a.aspect_key
WHERE a.notified_at IS NULL AND a.status = 'moi'
ORDER BY a.alert_key
LIMIT 50

={{ 'UPDATE dw.fact_alert SET notified_at = now() WHERE notified_at IS NULL AND alert_key IN (-1,' + $('Gộp thành một email').first().json.alert_keys.map(k => Number(k)).filter(k => Number.isSafeInteger(k)).join(',') + ')' }}
